description: This file implements a socket-to-socket proxy server for inter-process communication, including classes for managing proxy pairs and server logic for accepting connections and proxying data between sockets.

classes.name: ProxyPair
classes.description: Manages a pair of proxy threads that forward data between two sockets, with start, stop, and running status management.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Implements a server that accepts incoming socket connections and proxies data between client sockets and target sockets using ProxyPair instances.

methods.name: ProxyServer::Join
methods.description: Joins the server thread, waiting for it to finish.

methods.name: ProxyServer::~ProxyServer
methods.description: Destructor that signals the server to stop and waits for thread cleanup.

methods.name: Proxy
methods.description: Creates a ProxyServer instance and runs it, managing the lifecycle of the proxy.

methods.name: ProxyAsync
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a ProxyServer, starting the proxy asynchronously.
